title: Robocon support arm: AL-6061-T6 extruded bar 10 mm
description: Teaching case: A 100 mm long, 20 mm wide cantilever arm with 10 N downward tip load. Select 10 mm AL-6061-T6 extruded bar stock. Tip deflection limit 2.0 mm, minimum yield safety factor 2.0. Material from VTECH Datasheet Issue 5, Table 1, Row 3: yield 276 MPa typical for T6 temper, thickness interval (0, 25.4] mm. Density 2700 kg/m³, modulus 68.9 GPa.

materials.name: Aluminum 6061-T6
materials.provenance: Extruded bar, t ≤ 5 mm min yield 241 MPa per ASTM B221; t > 5 mm plate min yield 290 MPa per ASTM B209. Catalog uses typical yield 276 MPa for (0, 25.4] mm interval.
